title: Guidance to the Member Services Desk on Delivering the Cash Portion of a Membership and Patronage Equity Allocation
content:
The cash portion of a declared allocation under Membership and Patronage Equity is delivered by the methods the class allows and by no others.

**Offsetting is a term of the membership.** Where the class allows offsetting and the member owes the cooperative money, the cash portion is applied against what they owe before any payment is issued, in the offset priority order the class fixes, and the member receives only what is left. Offsetting is not a choice the member makes at the counter and not one the desk makes for them; it is a standing term of the membership.

**Where what is left is small.** Where the cash portion after offset falls under the class's payment minimum, nothing is issued and the amount is carried forward to the following year's cash portion rather than forfeited.

**Credit to the crop input account.** A member may ask for the cash portion to be credited onto their crop input account instead of paid, where the class allows that method, and the whole of it moves rather than part.

**The class figures.** The methods open, the payment minimum, whether the class offsets at all and the order in which accounts are offset are the figures the class carries.

## A clause of this guidance no longer in force

This sentence of the guidance is **no longer in force** and is set down only so that no reader applies it: "The cash portion is paid once per allocation notice, so a corrected notice is paid by a further row referencing the same notice and not by reissuing the first payment." What becomes of the cash already delivered on a notice that is afterwards restated is governed by the current basis, which is carried with the restatement rules. The clauses above, on the methods open, on offsetting, on the payment minimum and on crediting the crop input account, stand as clauses in force.

## Points of judgement on hypothetical figures

| Cash portion declared | What the member owes | Class payment minimum | What is issued |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 400.00 | nothing | 10.00 | 400.00 |
| 400.00 | 360.00 on the crop input account | 10.00 | 40.00 |
| 400.00 | 395.00 on the crop input account | 10.00 | nothing; 5.00 is carried forward to the following year's cash portion |
| 400.00 | 400.00 on the crop input account | 10.00 | nothing; the whole is taken in offset |

Where the member asks for the cash portion to be credited onto their crop input account on a class that allows the method, the whole of what is left after offset moves onto that account; the desk does not credit part and pay the rest.

superseded_clauses: The cash portion is paid once per allocation notice, so a corrected notice is paid by a further row referencing the same notice and not by reissuing the first payment.
